cover.coreProposition: Safe continuation requires a compound authority identity that binds workflow frame, call occurrence, branch identity, responder evidence and known effect state; robust event matching can decide pause, replay or continue, but it cannot authenticate the responder or prove exactly-once external effects.
cover.visualMetaphor: Five aligned identity rings must lock before a paused path can continue
cover.semanticObject: A suspended path passing through five distinct luminous rings
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with one interrupted path, five identity markers and a guarded continuation beyond them
